text: そろそろ　たたかわせて　みよう！

structure.jp: たたかわせて　みよう！
structure.en: let me try making them battle!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかわせて　みよう
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it and see'. たたかわせて みよう = 'I'll try making them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかわせる means making or letting someone else do it. たたかわせて = 'making them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: Changing みる to みよう makes it 'let's' or 'I think I will'. みよう = 'I'll give it a try'.
